0022600188.text: The Miami Heat (2-5, 11th in the East and 4th in the Southeast, 2 games back) visit the Golden State Warriors (5-3, 8th in the West and 2nd in the Pacific, 1 game back) after losing their last game and posting a 1-2 road record, while Golden State enters on a five-game winning streak. The Warriors are missing Gui Santos (knee), Jimmy Butler III (knee, surgery), Kristaps Porzingis (illness) and Moses Moody (knee, surgery), all listed as out. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27 and split their 2025-26 series 1-1, with the most recent meeting on January 19, 2026 in San Francisco, a 135-112 Heat loss.
